title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
company: Talent Sure Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Executive Assistant

Location: Glasgow / Hybrid

Hours: 37.5 hours a week (Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm)

Salary: Up to £42,000 per annum (Depending on Experience)

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

About the Opportunity

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a high-calibre Executive Assistant to join a leading, award winning corporate organisation.

This is not a traditional 1:1 support role. Our client operates a sophisticated, agile support model where the Executive Support team manages incoming requests and tasks directly from various senior leadership and UK Executive Team members. This is a fast-paced, high-visibility position perfect for an Executive Assistant who thrives on variety, collaboration, and working within a modern, forward-thinking corporate environment.

If you want to step away from traditional support structures and work as part of a highly dynamic, collaborative team, this role offers a fantastic platform to showcase your skills and gain valuable exposure to high-level corporate strategy.

Key Responsibilities
- Agile Executive Support: Respond to and manage incoming administrative requests from multiple senior executives, ensuring high-priority tasks are addressed efficiently.
- Strategic Diary Management: Proactively manage complex calendars, making strategic decisions on meeting precedence and liaising closely with other Executive Support team members.
- High-Level Documentation: Construct and produce detailed meeting agendas, briefing papers, and professional PowerPoint presentations for key strategy meetings.
- Communication Management: Screen and manage verbal and written communications for executive members, acting as a professional and effective gatekeeper.
- Logistics & Events: Coordinate complex travel, accommodation, and venue bookings, while providing coordination support for corporate roadshows and engagement events.
- Operational Administration: Support budget tracking, process executive expense claims, and manage the administrative onboarding and offboarding processes for team members.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a proactive, self-motivated professional who remains calm under pressure and uses their initiative to solve problems before they escalate. To be successful in this role, you will need:
- Proven Experience: Significant experience working at Senior Management or Personal Assistant level, ideally within a rapidly changing, fast-paced corporate environment.
- Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook. Experience using modern AI tools (such as Copilot) to drive daily administrative efficiencies is highly desirable.
- Communication Excellence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to adapt your tone for various senior and executive audiences.
- Organisational Mastery: Outstanding ability to handle multiple conflicting priorities and manage the expectations of senior stakeholders.
- Absolute Discretion: A proven track record of handling highly business-sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion.

Salary, Benefits & Culture

This organisation has been officially recognised as a leading UK employer, offering an inclusive, collaborative, and highly supportive environment where your development and support skills are fully valued. Alongside a highly competitive salary, you will receive a comprehensive and flexible rewards package:
- Flexible & Hybrid Working: Modern hybrid working options designed to support work-life balance, with flexibility around working hours and genuine part-time or job-share arrangements available.
- Generous Annual Leave: A highly competitive annual leave allowance with options to customise your holiday balance through buying and selling schemes.
- Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare options, including dental plans, health cash plans, screening services, and dedicated mental health and wellness support.
- Financial Benefits: Highly competitive corporate pension plans, regular salary reviews, discretionary bonus schemes, and exclusive employee savings and loan initiatives.
- Family-Friendly Policies: Enhanced paid parental and partner leave schemes, alongside structured return-to-work programmes to support family life.
- Perks & Lifestyle: Tech saving schemes, cycle-to-work programs, vehicle scheme options, and a variety of corporate lifestyle discounts and social club events.

How to Apply

If you possess the required expertise and are ready to make an immediate impact within a world-class support function, please apply with your CV today

title: Digital Helpdesk Support Apprentice
description:
DS Business Solutions is a leading provider of managed print services, document solutions, and IT support services. We work with organisations across a range of sectors, helping them improve productivity through innovative technology solutions, expert support, and outstanding customer service.

Our team supports customers with multifunctional devices (MFDs), business software, digital systems, and technical services. We pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our customers, providing reliable support and tailored solutions to meet their needs.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated apprentice to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop a career in IT and customer support while working towards a nationally recognised Digital Applications Support qualification.

About the role:

You will act as the first point of contact for customers requiring technical assistance and support. You will help users resolve a variety of digital and technology-related issues whilst developing valuable skills in troubleshooting, customer service, digital systems, and IT support.

Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will gain hands-on experience supporting customers both remotely and on-site, building technical knowledge across a range of systems, software applications, and business technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Act as the first point of contact for customer technical support enquiries via telephone, email, and digital support systems
- Log, monitor, update, and manage support tickets using the company's service management platform
- Develop expertise in DS Business Solutions' key business systems, including MPS Estate Management System, IT Database, Select Billing System, Service Logging System, Konica Minolta software applications and customer support tools
- Support customers with printing, scanning, networking, software, and connectivity issues
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, resolving first-line support requests wherever possible
- Escalate more complex technical issues to senior engineers and specialist support teams when required
- Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of multifunctional devices (MFDs) and associated software solutions
- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, support requests, resolutions, and technical updates
- Use digital tools and systems to monitor workloads, prioritise support requests, and track service delivery
- Produce reports and update system records to ensure data accuracy and service quality
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues and suggesting improvements to systems and processes

Required skills:
- A full, clean UK driving licence is required due to the field-based nature of the role
- Willingness to travel to customer sites as required
- A genuine interest in technology, IT support, and digital systems
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Eagerness to learn and develop new technical skills

Working hours: 8.30am - 5.30pm, Monday to Friday

What we offer:

We are committed to developing talent and helping our people build rewarding careers. You'll be joining a supportive team where you can learn from experienced professionals, gain industry-recognised qualifications, and play an important role in delivering exceptional service to our customers.
- Company vehicle provided for business use
- Laptop, tablet, and mobile phone supplied
- Full training on Konica Minolta devices, software, and managed print technologies
- Support towards completing a Digital Helpdesk Support SCQF Level 6 apprenticeship
- Ongoing mentoring and development from experienced engineers and technical specialists
- Quarterly performance bonus scheme
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience across IT support, customer service, digital systems, and managed print solutions
- Clear career progression opportunities within a growing technology business

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

title: Claims Handler (FTC)
description:
Claims Handler (12-Month FTC)

Glasgow £37.4k - £39.2k per annum (dependent on skills and qualifications)

Full-time

Joint-contribution pension from 6% (12% total) - Enhanced maternity & family leave - Life assurance - HolidayPlus - Virtual GP & Employee Assistance Programme plus retail and leisure discounts & many more.

REQ5995

At SGN, we rely on effective claims management to ensure claims are investigated, managed and resolved fairly, efficiently and in line with company policies and regulatory requirements. As a Claims Handler, you'll be responsible for managing public liability and/or recovery claims, providing a high-quality service.

We deliver safety, warmth, and comfort to homes and businesses. Every role, whether in the office or on the front line, plays a key part in this mission. Here's how you will contribute
- Receive, record, and acknowledge new claims, reviewing for completeness and coverage.
- Investigate, negotiate, settle, and maintain accurate records of claims, managing own caseload and escalating as needed.
- Work with legal support to resolve disputes.
- Authorise and approve claims in line with policies and legal frameworks (NSRWA 1991, Gas Act 1986).
- Follow best practices, adhere to policies and legal frameworks, and stay updated with relevant Case Law.
- Respond to inquiries about the claims/recovery process, providing clear and timely information.
- Provide excellent customer service, offering regular updates and promptly resolving issues.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and customers.
- Handle MoJ Portal Claims.
- Identify and pursue recovery opportunities, maximising recovery items and maintaining accurate records.
- Prepare reports on claim status and recovery performance, tracking KPIs.
- Identity and raise risks, issues, or exceptions related to claims/recovery analysis.
- Support the development of the claims management team and documentation.
- Identify opportunities to streamline processes and drive efficiencies.

What you will need
- Understanding of insurance principles, products and claims processes.
- Experience handling claims, including exposure to both defendant and claimant litigation.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Proven ability to influence, challenge and negotiate, using sound judgement to achieve positive outcomes
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple cases and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Not sure you meet every requirement?

Research shows some people - particularly women and those from underrepresented backgrounds - may hesitate to apply unless they meet every criteria. At SGN, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If this role interests you but you're not sure you tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you. You might be just who we're looking for - now or in the future.

Why SGN?

SGN leads pioneering research and development for a energy system. Our innovative technologies are transforming the gas industry while keeping people safe and warm. We are an award-winning employer, including CCA Gold Awards for Great Places to Work and Inclusivity and Accessibility , and a proud Gold member of the Armed Forces Covenant.

If you require any accommodations or support during the application process, reach out to us. We're here to help ensure an inclusive and accessible experience for everyone.

Maintain project trackers, build programmes, action logs, document registers, risk and issue logs, permit trackers, defect logs, site records and reporting schedules.

Liaise with Project Managers, Delivery Managers, site teams, civil gangs, fibre teams, designers, subcontractors, suppliers, clients, local authorities and statutory undertakers.

Coordinate streetworks permits, notices, traffic management requirements, drawings, project packs, specifications, method statements, risk assessments and inspection records.

Monitor build milestones, update progress records and identify delays, blockers and permit constraints.

Escalate project risks, delays and issues promptly.

Support procurement and resource coordination, including subcontractor details, civils materials, ducting, chambers, reinstatement materials, plant, deliveries and site access.

Ensure Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental documentation is requested, reviewed, distributed and filed correctly.

Support project handovers, reporting and close-out activities.

Key Relationships

You'll work with:

Project Managers and FTTH Delivery Managers.

Site Managers, Supervisors and civil gangs.

Civils, Fibre, Survey and Design teams.

Streetworks, permitting and local authority contacts.

Commercial, Finance, Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental teams.

Subcontractors, suppliers and plant providers.

Clients, network operators and statutory bodies.

About You

Strong administration, coordination and organisational skills.

Excellent attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.

Confident communicating with internal and external stakeholders.

Proactive, practical and comfortable chasing information and resolving issues.

Able to manage multiple projects, deadlines and competing priorities.

Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

Experience using project trackers, document registers or business management systems.

Understanding of project coordination, construction or infrastructure environments.

A flexible, positive "get stuck in" attitude.

Experience in FTTH, telecoms, civils, streetworks, utilities, construction or a similar infrastructure environment would be advantageous. However, transferable coordination skills and the right attitude are equally important.
